name: Product pitch and demo
summary: Present, then walk the buyer through what they would see, while they poke holes.
repBrief: A scheduled pitch and demo. You have 20 minutes. Present Shiftwise and walk the buyer through what they would see on screen (describe it out loud; there is no real screen). Expect hard questions.
buyerBrief: You agreed to see a pitch and demo. The rep will describe what is on their screen. Poke holes: ask how it handles your specific situation, ask about limitations, ask what happens when things go wrong. Reward specifics; punish feature lists.
winCondition: The buyer agrees to a pilot, a proposal, or a meeting with the decision-maker.
